newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebec signs economic agreement with Venezuela.
newsitem.headline: Quebec signs economic agreement with Venezuela.

text.p: The Canadian province of Quebec on Thursday signed an economic agreement with the Venezuelan state of Merida.

The accord, signed by Quebec Deputy premier Bernard Landry and Merida governor William Davila Barrios, promotes cooperation between both states in the economic, science, technological and cultural sectors. It puts the accent on the development of commercial trade between the two parties.
Venezuela is Quebec's third biggest business partner in Latin America. It is the fouth biggest client of Quebec.
Quebec's exports to Venezuela represent 10.5 percent of its exports to Latin America.
